== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from posts on the Players Committee forum. Topics used: 19270, 21362, 22883.
The cited posts are live forum.starwarsccg.org posts; they have no Internet Archive capture yet (forum snapshots are to be added later), so the refs carry no Preserved copy for now.
=== Identification ===
* Church's results (p308762) give first names. Aaron, Kevin, Scott and Joe are linked as [[Aaron Nelson]], [[Kevin Shannon]], [[Scott Church]] and [[Joe Olson]] (the same four finished first to fourth at the state championship the night before, and the bye post names Nelson, Olson and Church). Geoff is linked as [[Geoff Dearing]], who wrote that he would play both days. Jaron is [[Jaron Janson]] (Jerba, p308792). Surnames of Mikey (Martin) and Todd (Johnson) come from James Lewis (p328115); Charlie's surname is unknown.
* Chris, Andrew and James may be Chris Schoenthal, Andrew Nelson and James Lewis, who played the state championship the night before (Church expected "about 4 more" players on Saturday for 12 in all, p308685), but the posts do not say so; they are left unlinked.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Start time: the western calendar (t21362 p307955) and the February announcement give 11 am / 10 am; Church's results post says play started at 10:30 am. The page gives the announced 11 am start and the reported 10:30 start in the Results section.
=== Missing data ===
* Decks, other than Church's Dagobah Asteroids and Todd Johnson's DBO.
